description: Projectile/movement profiles for spawned effects: launch aiming, speed curve, homing, tilt, ground-following and a child ground effect.

ID.technical: FName row key. AGameEffect::Initialize resolves EffectRow.Id_EffectMove against EffectMoveDataTables (+0x690) with an inline first-match finder (retail 0x135cba0); None leaves movement unstarted. Character action controllers also fetch these rows directly by name (e.g. CN_050 StartMoveEase). 147 exported rows.

EffectMoveType.simple: How the initial direction is chosen (Straight/Target/Location).
EffectMoveType.technical: EGameEffectMoveType (0 None, 1 Straight, 2 Target, 3 Location). Straight uses the effect source's facing vector; Target uses the source's secondary target location (optionally clamped by Limit_AngleXY/Limit_AngleZ around the source's auto-aim); Location uses source->GetEffectMoveTargetLocation(). Unhandled/default types leave the direction unchanged. Export sample: Straight.

MoveDirection.simple: Direction offset/axis applied to the chosen launch orientation.
MoveDirection.technical: FVector. AimAlong first sets actor rotation from MakeFromX(launch direction), then rotates this row vector by that quaternion to produce the runtime MoveDirection; the result is normalized at the end of Start. With the usual (1,0,0) value, movement follows the chosen aim. Export sample: (1,0,0).

bHomingEnabled.simple: Whether the effect steers toward the source's secondary target.
bHomingEnabled.technical: bool. At Start the homing target is Source->GetSecondaryTargetActor(); each update (until Homing_Time elapses) refreshes its location and runs UpdateHomingXY/UpdateHomingZ. Also selects the homing branch of Update: tilt applies here, while Fall_AngularVelocityZ and along-ground movement are skipped. Export sample: true.

Speed_Start.technical: float UE units/s; first key of FloatInterp38.Start(Start, End, InterpolateTime, Easing, BlendExp, 2). Character movement controllers use the same pair for their own homing/dash speed curves, sometimes multiplied by an owner rate (e.g. GetCP240PassiveRate). Export sample: 6000.0.

Speed_End.technical: float UE units/s; target key of the same speed interpolator. In CN_050/CN_180/CN_220/CN_231/CN_270/CN_280 shikigami movement controllers and GameShikigamiMovementController these three fields plus easing/blend are read together. Export sample: 4500.0.

Speed_InterpolateTime.simple: Time over which speed changes from start to end.
Speed_InterpolateTime.technical: float seconds passed as the interpolation duration to the speed interpolator. Export sample: 0.5. Once elapsed, the current speed stays at Speed_End.

Speed_EasingType.simple: Easing curve for the speed change.
Speed_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType (None/EaseIn/EaseOut/EaseInOut) converted by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc (0x1412fa480) and passed to the speed interpolator. Export sample: None.

Speed_Blend_Exp.simple: Exponent/shape parameter of the speed easing.
Speed_Blend_Exp.technical: float passed as the 'exp' argument (with a literal 2 for the final argument) of the speed interpolator Start; used across all identified consumers of this row's speed curve. Export sample: 1.0.

Delay_Time.technical: float seconds; Start stores max(Delay_Time, UE_KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER) when Delay_Time<=0, and Update decrements DelayTime by DeltaSeconds and returns until it reaches zero. A non-positive value therefore introduces only a negligible one-tick-like delay. Export sample: 0.0.

Fall_AngularVelocityZ.simple: Downward arc turn rate for non-homing effects.
Fall_AngularVelocityZ.technical: float degrees/second; when >0 in the non-homing update, MoveDirection is rotated about the effect's local right axis by DeltaSeconds * this value and the actor quaternion is rebuilt via MakeFromXY. Export sample: 0.0 (straight travel).

Limit_AngleXY.technical: float degrees. For EffectMoveType::Target with either limit positive, the initial target direction is clamped around the source's auto-aim yaw by this angle. During homing, UpdateHomingXY returns when the XY angle to the target is >= Limit_AngleXY (when >0). Values <=0 disable that clamp. Export sample: 40.0.

Limit_AngleZ.technical: float degrees; clamps the initial target elevation relative to the source's aim and later caps UpdateHomingZ's vertical steering. <=0 disables the clamp. Export sample: 40.0.

Homing_AngularVelocityXY.technical: float degrees/second. UpdateHomingXY returns when <=0; otherwise steps MoveDirection by DeltaSeconds * rate toward the target's XY bearing (sign from the 2D cross product), clamped to the remaining angle and suppressed past Limit_AngleXY. Export sample: 1.0.

Homing_AngularVelocityZ.technical: float degrees/second; UpdateHomingZ transforms the target into effect-local space, measures the elevation angle and rotates MoveDirection about its local right axis by DeltaSeconds * rate toward the target, clamped to the angle and Limit_AngleZ. Export sample: 1.0.

Homing_Time.technical: float seconds. HomingElapsed starts at 0 and increments while !(HomingElapsed > Homing_Time && Homing_Time > 0); once that fails, XY/Z steering stops but movement continues. <=0 means unlimited homing. Export sample: 0.0.

bTilt.simple: Bank the homing effect into turns.
bTilt.technical: bool; only consumed in the homing branch. The turn rate (2D angle between previous and new direction * 10, capped at 30 degrees) becomes a roll offset that approaches/leaves at 60 degrees per second (TiltRoll). Export sample: false.

bAlongGroundEnabled.simple: Sliding movement along the ground instead of free flight.
bAlongGroundEnabled.technical: bool; only used in the non-homing branch. MoveAlongGround performs up to 10 capsule sweeps of radius AlongGroundHeight*mean actor scale, projects the direction along hit normals (slopes above 65 degrees are ignored), then line-probes downward and optionally aligns rotation. Export sample: false.

bAlongGroundDownEnabled.simple: Use a deeper ground probe and accept any ground normal when following ground.
bAlongGroundDownEnabled.technical: bool used only by MoveAlongGround: doubles the downward probe depth when on ground, and determines the ground-acceptance test (true accepts any hit; false requires Dot(ImpactNormal, MoveDirection) < -0.0). Export sample: false.

bIsStoppedOnAir.simple: Finish the effect if no ground is found while ground-following.
bIsStoppedOnAir.technical: bool; at the end of MoveAlongGround, when the downward probe reports no ground hits, the effect actor is finished. Only reachable with bAlongGroundEnabled=true. Export sample: false.

AlongGroundHeight.technical: float multiplied by the mean of the effect actor's XYZ scale ((X+Y+Z)/3) to form the capsule sweep radius and the downward probe depth (doubled when bAlongGroundDownEnabled && on ground). Export sample: 0.0 (all exported rows in the sampled set).

Id_Effect_AlongGround.simple: Child effect spawned at the ground under the moving effect.
Id_Effect_AlongGround.technical: FName; skipped when None. UpdateAlongGroundEffect line-traces downward by AlongGroundEffect_Height * mean actor scale; on a hit it resolves this ID to an Effect row and spawns/initializes a child effect (pooled when PoolCount>0), placing it at ImpactPoint and orienting it to the hit normal. On a miss an existing child is finished. Export sample: None.

AlongGroundEffect_Height.simple: Downward trace length for the ground child effect.
AlongGroundEffect_Height.technical: float multiplied by the effect's mean actor scale to determine the End point of the line trace used by UpdateAlongGroundEffect. Only read when Id_Effect_AlongGround is not None. Export sample: 0.0.

notes: EffectMoveDataTables is manager slot +0x690; registered at GameDataTableManager.cpp:407 and resolved at line 235.

The row has two largely exclusive feature branches: homing (bHomingEnabled with bTilt and Homing_* steering) and non-homing (Fall_AngularVelocityZ plus optional along-ground movement). The speed/delay fields are common to both. The initial aim direction also depends on EffectMoveType and Limit_AngleXY/Z even without homing.

The same row struct is reused outside effect actors by character/shikigami movement controllers (CN_050, CN_180, CN_220, CN_231, CN_270, CN_280, GameCharacterMovementController, GameShikigamiMovementController), which read Speed_* and Homing_* for their own easing states rather than starting UGameEffectMovementController.
No localization variants or numbered shards exist in the export; the 147 rows are distinct named movement profiles.

usages.detail: Effect initialization resolves Id_EffectMove and starts UGameEffectMovementController with the row (retail 0x135cba0).
Start chooses the launch direction from EffectMoveType, source facing/target/location and limit angles, then arms speed and delay.
Update applies homing/tilt or fall/ground movement, moves the actor and updates the ground child effect.
MoveAlongGround implements the bAlongGroundEnabled/DownEnabled/StopOnAir and Height behaviour (retail 0x14133A590).
A non-effect consumer fetches an EffectMove row by name and uses its speed curve for a character action (retail 0x141463CE0).
